divmod separates whole minutes from leftover seconds. Adding a minute when the leftover is 30 or more implements round-half-up exactly as specified, since 30 seconds is the half-minute. Near the end of a day, 86399 seconds rounds to 1440 minutes and prints as '24:00'; the spec does not ask for wrapping at midnight, so that is reasonable. Hours beyond 99 would print with three digits, which again conflicts with nothing stated. The computation depends only on the input value.
